clauses.text:
1. Purpose:
These notes document the negotiation considerations and observations for the upcoming renewal of the Master Service Agreement (MSA) between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (Vendor) and FinSecure Services (Client). The objective is to ensure that obligations, invoicing processes, SLAs, and dispute management are aligned to reduce risk, prevent revenue leakage, and optimize service delivery.

1. Purpose:
These notes document the negotiation considerations and observations for the upcoming renewal of the Master Service Agreement (MSA) between PrimeVolta Hardware Solutions (Vendor) and FinSecure Services (Client). The objective is to ensure that obligations, invoicing processes, SLAs, and dispute management are aligned to reduce risk, prevent revenue leakage, and optimize service delivery.

clauses.text: Delivery & Fulfillment: Consider stricter timelines or additional buffer clauses to prevent SLA breaches during high-demand periods.

clauses.text: Revenue Assurance: Implement automated alerts to detect potential under-billing or over-billing scenarios before invoices are sent.

clauses.text: Escalation & Dispute Resolution: Maintain multi-tiered escalation process but reduce resolution timelines to 10 business days.
